## Activity

Market Eye Clinic recorded 142 captures during April 2020. This provides the activity total for the month and supports review of the site’s screening workload. No additional activity figures are reported in this summary.

## Image quality

Image quality was assessed for the completed captures. There were 9 ungradable captures, representing an ungradable rate of 6.3 per cent. These images could not be used for grading and should remain visible in routine site monitoring. Staff raised no new equipment faults this month.

## Grading

A total of 22 results were graded referable during April 2020. The median grading lag was 1 day. This indicates the typical interval between image submission and completion of grading for the reporting period. The referable results and the ungradable captures should be considered separately when reviewing performance, as they describe different stages of the screening process. Overall, the report records the site’s capture volume, image quality, grading outcome and grading timeliness for the month.
